messages:
sophie_sales: Hey team — FinLedger asked for a compact proofpack for their POC. They specifically want SOC2 excerpt (controls around encryption & change mgmt), a signed pen-test letter template we can provide, and clarification on how Dedicated pricing changes if they require VPC + tenant isolation. Timeline: they want this bundled by EOW if possible.
allan_se: Thanks Sophie. Quick checklist I can assemble today: SOC2 excerpt (PDF), pen-test letter template (signed by provider/attestor), network diagram for dedicated, short note on KMS separation options. Do we have a one-pager on residency + pricing delta?
marcus_security: Re: pen-test letter — we have a standard attestation doc but external scans need an authorized signer. Will need legal to sign if customer requires formal letterhead. For SOC2 excerpt, confirm which controls they want called out (CC6, CC7?).
ops_jen: For Dedicated/VPC: pricing delta depends on: reserved vGPU counts, single-tenant tenancy vs shared with strict isolation, and egress/backhaul requirements. If they want on-prem escort or air-gapped staging, that's a separate services quote. I can draft numbers but need their expected QPS and peak seq len.
sophie_sales: They said typical batch workloads ~40 requests/s, 2k mean seq length, burst to 200/s for short windows. Residency: UK preferred, but could accept eu-west if pricing jump is too big. Also they flagged supply-chain questions re: third-party deps — any quick notes?
allan_se: Copying what I'll attach: 1) SOC2 excerpt PDF (controls we usually surface) 2) Network diagram (VPC peering & egress paths) 3) Pen-test attestation template (editable) 4) Short tech note on KMS/HSM separation + ephemeral keys for POC.
marcus_security: For 3rd-party dependencies: we can provide a short matrix listing our critical OSS libs + mitigation (SLA patching cadence, vuln scanning cadence). That usually satisfies procurement for a POC. Also recommend adding: "pen-test window & signatory" row so they see timelines.
ops_jen: Quick question — do we let them run an external authn scan against staging? If yes, we need to share approved IP ranges and a 72h window. That affects scheduling for oncall and could delay EOW.
sophie_sales: Good point. I'll ask FinLedger if external scan is required for POC. If they just want the attestation + evidence bundle we can hit EOW. If they want an active scan we'll push to next week.
allan_se: Draft of the email I'll send to the customer (will attach artifacts):
```
Hi Tom — attaching the POC evidence bundle per our call: SOC2 excerpt, pen-test attestation template, network diagram, and a short note on KMS and dependency management. If you'd like an external scan we can schedule a 72h window and provide staging IPs; otherwise the bundle should cover procurement for a POC.
Regards,
Allan
```
marcus_security: Also adding: include the signed pen-test letter only after legal confirms signatory. We can attach unsigned template but mark it as "sample".
sophie_sales: Thanks — action items: Allan to drop the bundle here by EOD, Marcus to add the dependency matrix + signatory note, Jen to draft a dedicated pricing delta table based on 40rps baseline. I'll ping legal if they require signed letter. :thumbsup: 
ops_jen: I'll prepare a short pricing table (baseline hosted vs dedicated single-tenant vs dedicated VPC) and include estimated commit tiers. Will post numbers in thread.
security_bot: /reminder set for allan_se to post bundle by 17:00 today
sophie_sales: Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. I'll update customer after we post. :rocket:
